purpose: Separate numerical axes for fixed first-round designs; no search or new physical calibration
holdout_rule: The identical first four original holdout latent draws, plus a separate zero-perturbation row. No new draw selection.

acceptance.threshold: 0.2 * min(abs(current paired mean CV gap), abs(original refined16 mean CV gap))
acceptance.requirements: Each method mean and paired gap must change less than threshold for the last two refinements, with the same nonzero gap sign across the last three levels. Phase-offset spread must also be below threshold for both methods. Require full-disk and fixed interior90 diagnostics; a pass is conditional numerical stability, not a rigorous physical error bound.
acceptance.scope: Only fixed designs and the four specified held-out scenarios; cannot establish machine robustness or global optimality.

phase_interpretation: Quadrature nodes at (k+alpha)*dt in the original integration window, implemented by equivalent carrier/planet phase shifts (alpha-0.5)*dt. This probes numerical node-origin sensitivity, not physical startup-phase uncertainty.
status: Predefined before pilot; execute only levels justified by measured pilot cost. All skips reported.
